review.scope: One exact terminal fixed-Commit admission result and the directly requested contract answer; no consent for future contact.

responseBody:
## dsh-skill-install 0.1.6 — rejected

Fixed Commit: `c03b72d85a391d1f510df0e61d12836649a10abc`. The complete bounded source (7 files, 171,044 bytes) was read and hash-checked. PATH001 and COMPAT001 are fixed: archive member path/type checks run before extraction, and the manifest declares DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 compatible. Admission is still rejected for **PATH002**.

At [index.js:482-483](https://github.com/Joey-K-tsubame/dsh-skill-install/blob/c03b72d85a391d1f510df0e61d12836649a10abc/index.js#L482-L483), the aggregate expanded-byte limit is counted only by `sanitizeTree`. [index.js:552-557](https://github.com/Joey-K-tsubame/dsh-skill-install/blob/c03b72d85a391d1f510df0e61d12836649a10abc/index.js#L552-L557) starts and completes `tar -xzf` before that check. A highly compressed archive can therefore consume disk before rejection.

**Minimal change:** enforce per-member and aggregate expanded-byte limits before writing members, or use an equivalently bounded extractor. Keep the current path/type checks and staging cleanup.

**Acceptance:** an over-budget compressed fixture is rejected before writes cross the cap, leaves the install target untouched, cleans staging, and valid archives still pass.

## dsh-delete-archived 0.1.2 — rejected

Fixed Commit: `437d935129368b7cdde68a862c6b47cb4e6c895d`. The complete bounded source (6 files, 26,152 bytes) was read and hash-checked. DELETE001 and COMPAT001 are fixed: the pending journal is written before persistence removal and the manifest declares DSH 0.2.1-rc.2. Admission is still rejected for **DELETE002**.

[lib/entry.js:116-120](https://github.com/Joey-K-tsubame/dsh-delete-archived/blob/437d935129368b7cdde68a862c6b47cb4e6c895d/lib/entry.js#L116-L120) accepts any parsed object as a journal. [lib/entry.js:283-292](https://github.com/Joey-K-tsubame/dsh-delete-archived/blob/437d935129368b7cdde68a862c6b47cb4e6c895d/lib/entry.js#L283-L292) skips the archived-session check whenever that file exists, without validating its schema or matching `sessionId`.

**Minimal change:** validate the exact journal schema and require its `sessionId` to match the requested session before treating it as a resumable deletion; reject malformed or mismatched journals without bypassing the archived gate.

**Acceptance:** disposable fixtures cover a valid same-session retry, wrong session ID, arbitrary object, malformed JSON, and invalid timestamp; only the valid retry resumes, while invalid cases leave persistence and registry state untouched.

The request in `lib/client.js:55` calls the same-origin DSH plugin list route, so Catalog network permission is `none`. The author-provided DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 install/start/uninstall evidence is not Store runtime verification. DSH STORE did not execute third-party code or tests. Both Catalog entries remain blocked and both Issues remain open. Full fixed-source decisions and hashes are in https://github.com/AI-Scarlett/DSH-Store/blob/main/docs/reviews/external-review-20261019.md.

This is one response for both explicit requests; neither request will receive a second message.
